nodes.name: Clicks
nodes.source: Official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (JPG), supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [menlyn-lf-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.8)
nodes.notes: F12: public-corridor point abreast of the Clicks block (logo centroid source px 590,415). Corridor ARRIVAL point, not the storefront door (F13: door not depicted; field verification required). Clicks lies west of the corridor: on the shopper's right when walking in from Entrance 13.

nodes.name: Entrance 13
nodes.source: Official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (JPG), supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [menlyn-lf-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.8)
nodes.notes: F09/F10: circled '13' marker on the mall boundary below the orange P5 parking, at the head of a corridor; drawn on the LF sheet → opens onto LF, no floor transition. Orange Parking / Atterbury Road side.

nodes.name: Cross corridor
nodes.source: Official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (JPG), supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [menlyn-lf-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.8)
nodes.notes: F11: junction of the north–south corridor from Entrance 13 with the east–west public corridor; no other cross corridor between the entrance and this junction.

instructions.forward: Walk straight into the mall along the corridor until you reach the cross corridor.

edges.source: Official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (JPG), supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [menlyn-lf-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.8)
edges.notes: Inside the public corridor between the mr price home block (west) and the Ackermans block (east); vertical, no diagonal, crosses no wall or store. length_px on the 1280-wide rendering (F14).

instructions.forward: Continue straight across the cross corridor. Clicks is on your right, just past the crossing.

edges.source: Official Menlyn Park 'LOWER FIRST LEVEL' map (JPG), supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03 [menlyn-lf-map] (visual_first_party, confidence 0.8)
edges.notes: Same corridor continuing south of the cross corridor; Clicks block on the west side. length_px on the 1280-wide rendering (F14).
